name: ${mod_name}
_comment: No `breaks` block on purpose: Aetherium degrades instead of refusing to start.
ModConflictScanner detects Sodium, Embeddium, VulkanMod and other renderer mods and delegates the overlapping feature off, which keeps a modpack launchable.
Declaring them broken would turn a soft conflict into a hard one, the opposite of the design in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
A pack that wants a hard guarantee can add its own `breaks` entry.
